name: craftsandcrumbscafe
description: A full-stack café ordering platform. Customer storefront, admin dashboard, and rider app, built with Firebase (Auth + Firestore) and PayMongo for GCash/QRPH/card payments.

paragraphs: A Firebase-powered ordering platform for a café that also sells handmade merch. It's three apps sharing one backend: a customer storefront, an admin dashboard, and a rider app — all backed by Firestore for data and Firebase Auth for role-based access.
features: Browse drinks, pastries, and merch by category, with search and sorting
Variable pricing by size and customizable options (e.g. drink add-ons), with live price/calorie recalculation
Cart, wishlist, and saved delivery addresses (with map-based address picking via Leaflet)
Guest checkout (anonymous auth) or full account with email OTP verification
Cash, QR Ph, and Credit/Debit Card payments via PayMongo

whatItDoes.text: A Firebase-powered ordering platform for a café that also sells handmade merch. It's three apps sharing one backend: a customer storefront, an admin dashboard, and a rider app — all backed by Firestore for data and Firebase Auth for role-based access.

requirements.text: Admin and rider accounts are regular Firebase Auth users whose Firestore users/{uid} document has role set accordingly — there's no separate signup flow for staff; roles are assigned from the Admin dashboard's Accounts tab.
Create a free account at cloudinary.com.
